chunks: If a person performing tamattu‘ wishes to leave Makkah for some other places, that is not permitted for him, because he is bound to the hajj until he completes it, unless he knows that the hajj will not escape him. So if he knows, and leaves, and returns in the month in which he left, he enters Makkah in a state of being non-muhrim; but if he enters it in a month other than that month, he enters it in a state of ihram.

key_terms.لَا يَفُوتُهُ اَلْحَجُّ: that the hajj will not be missed
key_terms.مُرْتَبِطٌ بِالْحَجِّ: legally bound to the hajj rites until completion

ai.seo_question: Can a mutamatti‘ leave Makkah before completing hajj and return without ihram?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling for the mutamatti‘ during hajj. It states that leaving Makkah is generally not allowed before completing the hajj, except when one is certain the hajj will not be missed, and the ruling of re-entry depends on whether the return is within the same month or a different month.
